verdict.rationale: Raygun's own docs confirm automatic error grouping based on exception type, class name, method name and location within the stack trace, which covers the deduplication half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to customize or override grouping when it is wrong; ignore rules and error statuses are triage controls, not grouping customization. Missing for 10: documented custom grouping or fingerprint override (e.g. custom grouping keys or merging/splitting groups), and independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping quality at scale.
